showGameBackground.label: Show Game Covers
showGameBackground.description: Shows cover art on the recording card and the game integration cards.

showLiveSessionCard.label: Show Session Being Recorded
showLiveSessionCard.description: Shows the session being recorded first in Full Sessions so you can watch and clip it before the recording stops.

showNewBadgeOnVideos.label: Show New Badge
showNewBadgeOnVideos.description: Marks sessions and replays from the last hour that you haven't opened yet with a <badge>NEW</badge> badge.

confirmBeforeDeleting.label: Confirm Before Deleting
confirmBeforeDeleting.description: Asks before videos, recovered recordings or game paths are deleted.

showAudioWaveformInTimeline.label: Show Audio Waveform
showAudioWaveformInTimeline.description: Draws the audio waveform along the video editor timeline.

showClipToolsOnClips.label: Show Clip Tools on Clips and Highlights
showClipToolsOnClips.description: Shows the Create Clip and Add Segment buttons when watching a clip or highlight.

showVideoNavigation.label: Show Previous and Next Video
showVideoNavigation.description: Shows the <back/> and <forward/> buttons in the video player to go to the previous or next video in the list.

showBookmarksInFullscreen.label: Show Bookmarks in Fullscreen
showBookmarksInFullscreen.description: Shows bookmarks above the seek bar in the fullscreen video player.

menu.title: Sidebar Menu
menu.description: Drag to reorder. Pick which page opens on launch. Hide items you don't use.
menu.forcedShown: Still shown in the sidebar because it has videos

default.hidden: Hidden Pages Can't Open on Launch
